name: kip-learn-decode
description: Regenerates prose from a candidate graph ALONE (never from the original document) in the run's rawKind format, stores it with putBlob and returns the real BlobRef. Storing a blob is not authoring a fact: a blob is content, not knowledge, and is never a member of S (ADR-B10a). The outputSchema below is deliberately STRICT — learn() reads this payload with a bare type assertion, so this schema is the guard (ADR-B10d trap 1).
